description:
Numeris is Canada’s most trusted and authoritative source for broadcast measurement and consumer behaviour data. As well, the industry leading intelligence provider to broadcasters, advertisers, and agencies. We have been recognized for over 75 years as providing the gold standard in audience intelligence. 
 
We have great people who do exceptional work. We take pride in building an environment of continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Our teams are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to creating quality experiences. We love what we do, enjoy each other’s company, and support initiatives to give back to our communities. We are looking for people to help us shape the future of Numeris, and have a lot of fun along the way.

The Panel Administrator acts as the Numeris contact for panel households comprised of individuals of all ages in English. The incumbent is responsible for supporting panel members to maximize panelist compliance with Numeris participation standards, primarily through telephone communications with the respondents. The Panel Administrator performs duties in accordance with written procedures and quality assurance practices, and works evening and weekend shifts.

What you will do

  • Motivate panelists to meet daily requirements for meter wear time using customer service and sales techniques over the telephone and via email. This includes both outbound and inbound communication with panel members, escalating unusual situations to a supervisor
  • Analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources (work orders, details on meter use patterns, various SharePoint lists, automated Task List, procedural documents, ad hoc instructions from Supervisors) to identify an appropriate course of action to correct issues of respondent non-compliance and/or equipment malfunction
  • Ensure that panel homes have the equipment and information they need to achieve participation standards
  • Keep accurate records of contact with respondents, updating proprietary databases and web applications

    • What you have

  • Experience in Customer Service, Sales or Market Research
  • Minimum of a College Degree or higher in market research or a related field
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends flexibly

    • What's in it for you?

    What's in it for you?

  • Comprehensive online and videocall training program with support to prepare you for the role
  • Ability to do your work from the comfort of your own home

    •  

    This role is part-time, 20 hours per week at a rate of $23.55 per hour.

    Values
     

    Stronger Together:

    We succeed through collaboration with each other and with the industry. Unity drives our impact.

    Innovation with Intent:

    We embrace change and challenge convention. Our innovation is purposeful, driven by insights, guided by strategy, and focused on delivering meaningful future-proofed solutions.

    We Before Me: 

    We put shared goals at the centre of how we work. By supporting one another, sharing accountability, and valuing diverse perspectives, we create an environment where people contribute fully and teams achieve more together.

    Excellence in Motion:

    We pursue continuous improvement in everything we do, from our processes to our time to market. With a growth mindset and a commitment to excellence, we bring solutions to life with precision and purpose.
     

    Numeris is an equal opportunity employer

    We are committed to creating an accessible environment for all our employees and foster a culture that focuses on diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging. We believe that a diverse workforce helps everyone contribute in meaningful ways towards our shared success.
